title: Desk Guidance: Paystride Save Alongside a Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan
content:
Holding a Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan changes automatic saving in Paystride Save. The desk applies the following rule to every Paystride Save tier.

> Auto-save is never taken from early wage transfers to the card when auto-save from early wage transfers is not allowed on the tier, so early pay is never swept into savings. While the worker's Access plan has an open shortfall, auto-save pauses when the tier pauses auto-save during an Access shortfall, and resumes with the next payroll load after the shortfall is recovered or written off; round-ups and manual transfers continue. A card autorecovery debit is not a purchase and never generates a round-up when the tier does not generate round-ups from autorecovery debits. Savings are never used to recover an Access shortfall.

## The rule point by point

| Situation on the worker's Access plan or card | Auto-save | Round-ups | Manual transfers |
|---|---|---|---|
| An early wage transfer arrives on the card | not taken from that transfer | — | — |
| The Access plan has an open shortfall | paused | continue | continue |
| The shortfall has been recovered or written off | resumes with the next payroll load after that | continue | continue |
| A card autorecovery debit posts | — | no round-up from that debit | — |

Separately from these four rows, money in Paystride Save is never used to recover an Access shortfall.

## Tier figures this rule reads

| Tier | Auto-save taken from early wage transfers to the card | Highest round-up multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Paystride Save Starter | No | 1 |
| Paystride Save Builder | No | 2 |
| Paystride Save Boost | No | 2 |
| Paystride Save Growth | No | 3 |
| Paystride Save Premier | No | 3 |
| Paystride Save Elite | No | 5 |

## Points of judgement

**When does a paused auto-save start again?** With the next payroll load after the shortfall is recovered or written off. A payroll load that arrives while the shortfall is still open is not auto-saved.

**Do round-ups stop during an open shortfall?** No. Only auto-save pauses; round-ups and manual transfers continue.

**Is a card autorecovery debit rounded up like a purchase?** No. It is not a purchase, and it generates no round-up.

**Can a Paystride Save balance be applied to an Access shortfall?** No. Savings are never used to recover an Access shortfall.

### Example (hypothetical sequence)

A worker's Access plan shows an open shortfall. A payroll load arrives on the card while it is open: no auto-save is taken from it, while that evening's round-ups are swept as usual. The shortfall is later recovered. The next payroll load after the recovery is auto-saved at the worker's chosen percentage again.
